```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropics==0.1.0 promptfoo==0.1.0 sonarsource-sonarqube-scan-action==7.0.0 codecov-test-results-action==1.0.0 github-codeql-action==3.0.0

      - name: Run Claude Code review
        id: claude_review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          prompt: "Please review this pull request for any issues including bugs, memory leaks, security vulnerabilities, and code style violations."

      - name: Check review outcome
        if: steps.claude_review.outputs.conclusion == 'approved'
        run: echo "Claude Code has approved the PR."
        
      - name: Check review outcome
        if: steps.claude_review.outputs.conclusion == 'changes_requested'
        run: echo "Claude Code has requested changes to the PR."
        
      - name: Check review outcome
        if: steps.claude_review.outputs.conclusion == 'rejected'
        run: echo "Claude Code has rejected the PR."
        
      - name: Run SonarQube scan
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v7
        with:
          args: "-Dsonar.projectKey=xbmc_inputstream_adaptive -Dsonar.sources=. -Dsonar.host.url=https://sonarcloud.io -Dsonar.login=${{ secrets.SONAR_CLOUD_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./coverage
```
